title: Bad news for Bordeaux: France's celebrated wine industry faces wake-up call over wildfires
summary: France's largest wine region is facing a wake-up call as the wildfires blazing near Bordeaux's famed vineyards underscore the climate challenges posed by severe drought and repeated heatwaves.
